set.body:
Goal
Write the mathematical, computational, and inferential contract before modifying scores or inspecting further retrieval outcomes.

Deliverables
- A versioned protocol defining coordinates and units, duration mass, order clock, local-neighbour rule, coverage parameterization, warp policy, candidate priors, folds, calibration, missing-data handling, diagnostics, seeds, stopping rules, and baseline panel.
- A golden Transport v2 fixture and manifest so every later optimization can distinguish intended estimator change from numerical drift.
- Prespecified synthetic, study-positive-control, runtime, calibration, and no-go thresholds.

Acceptance criteria
- The objective explicitly separates coverage M, normalized correspondence Gamma, selected source/target mass, spatial residual, chronology residual, correspondence smoothing, and warp penalty.
- gaze_info_bits is the sole default inferential endpoint; odds_bits and alignment components are secondary.
- The protocol states that coupling diffuseness is alignment ambiguity induced partly by regularization, not psychological uncertainty.
- No response, saliency, correctness, or retrieval subgroup is used to choose model form or hyperparameters.
- Every comparator is assigned identical outer folds, candidate pools, priors, and registration opportunities.
- A machine-readable frozen manifest and human-readable decision table are committed without private data.
set.title: GW-18.1 Freeze the Transport v3 estimand and blinded evaluation protocol
